# Icons and glyphs

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/pick.py --write-docs references` from assets/library/techniques.json. Edit the JSON, then regenerate. -->

Glyphs and icons as actors: a glyph that seeds the film, swaps on a tick or becomes a piece of UI. 11 entries, by category and role. The [index](../technique-library.md) lists every family and each category's house rule.

### A single glyph grows, spins upright and opens the film

`dv-glyph-seed-open` · opening hooks · signature · energy calm · launch, sting

A single small mark appears at the frame centre on a dark ground, grows (half size within 2-3 f) and spins to upright on a longer, softer curve, landing exactly when the next device (a mask) starts; later it turns into a hole of the ground's colour and shrinks out spinning.

- **Build:** Recipe: an SVG mark with scale and rotate on separate curves. Anatomy: Scale on a steep ease-out over 40 f; rotation 65 -> 180 deg on a longer tail; invert in 1 f; exit shrink on an ease-in. Sound: The first music note at 0.05 s.
- **Ban-safe variant (the default):** The brand's mark or a plain dot as the seed. The full look relies on sparkle; use it only when the brand supplies that look.
- **Timing:** 64 f in; exit 52 f.
- **Use when:** Cold opens; a mark that seeds an iris.
- **Avoid when:** A sparkle as decoration (use the brand's own mark or a neutral shape).

### An icon stands in for a word in the sentence

`dv-icon-in-sentence` · typography in motion · signature · energy calm · launch, feature

An icon takes a word's place inside the line: a mascot pops in where the next word would be while the giant word re-sets smaller; an outlined chip with an app logo sits inside the sentence, arriving in the accent and cooling, heating up before it swaps; a round clock icon between two words pops from 0.7 from defocus, saturates, then its hand ticks.

- **Build:** Words with an inline element slot (a span with an icon), entering with Oversize from 0.7. Anatomy: Icon 1.3-2x cap height; pop 7-30 f; colour cool 10 f, heat 15 f before a swap. Sound: The spoken word. Materials: An inline brand chip changes brand by rolling: the old content warms and fades, then rolls up out of the pill while the new name rolls in from below (both visible for 2 f), the pill's 1 px border following the text colour; 16 f in all.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Words`
- **Materials:** An inline brand chip changes brand by rolling: the old content warms and fades, then rolls up out of the pill while the new name rolls in from below (both visible for 2 f), the pill's 1 px border following the text colour; 16 f in all.
- **Timing:** 10-30 f.
- **Use when:** Product names, apps, time, anything the viewer knows as an icon.
- **Avoid when:** Icons that are unreadable at line size (at least 1.33x the cap height).

### Arrows as motion motifs

`dv-arrow-motifs` · layout and composition · accent · energy medium · launch, feature

An arrow splits into a row of arrow glyphs pointing in different directions (each new glyph ink for one frame, then the accent); outlined chevrons rise past a word; pale arrows drift outward from a hero icon; a white arrow shoots from the frame edge into its target in 2 frames and holds.

- **Build:** Recipe: SVG arrow glyphs with HardStep colour and simple transforms. Anatomy: Glyph row tightening on an ease-out; chevrons decelerating; drift 120 px; shoot 2 f. Sound: The voice onset on the shoot.
- **Timing:** 5-25 f.
- **Use when:** Direction, growth, uploads, "go".
- **Avoid when:** Decorative arrows that point nowhere.

### Hero icon becomes the inline glyph

`lc-hero-flips-to-inline-glyph` · layout and composition · accent · energy medium · launch, feature, sting

The centred hero icon shrinks and travels into a slot at the start of, or inside, a sentence, and the words of the claim spill out of it, so the icon becomes a word.

- **Build:** Lay out the final line first with an empty inline slot one cap height square (inkBox gives the cap height, measureTracked the widths), and read the slot's rect. FLIP the hero from its centred rect to that rect with translate and scale on prog(f, a, a + 26, E.smooth), with motion blur while it exceeds 12 px/f; for extra life add a wobble of rotateY = sin(pi p) * 25 deg and rotateX = -sin(pi p) * 15 deg under perspective(800px). The words start behind the icon in z and spill outward: each word's translateX runs from -24 px to 0 over 14 f on E.out while its opacity rises and its colour moves from C.mute to C.ink through mixColor over 12 f. The first word starts 2 f after the icon lands and the rest follow 4 f apart; then the line drifts at 0.5 px/f.
- **Timing:** Icon travel 22-30 f on E.smooth, scaling to about 0.42 (cap height). Words at icon landing + 2, + 6 and + 10 f, each a 14 f slide of 24 px with a 12 f colour resolve. Residual drift 0.5-1 px/f.
- **Use when:** Bridging from a hero object to a claim about it: an icon becoming the bullet of its benefit, a mark becoming the subject of a sentence, a feature glyph leading a metric line.
- **Avoid when:** Detailed icons that will not read at cap height (50-90 px), or sentences long enough to wrap.

### Icon-led ragged word stack

`lc-icon-ragged-stack` · layout and composition · accent · energy medium · launch, feature, vertical

A short lead word is followed by three or four keywords on separate lines, each with a small line icon, set at staggered x positions so the list has a rag instead of bullets.

- **Build:** Build a flex column with one row per keyword. Each row is a 1 em inline SVG line icon (stroke width matching the type's stem, coloured like the text) followed by the word, shifted by translateX from a fixed rag table such as [0, +120, -60, +180] px. The lead word sits above in C.mute; the keywords are C.ink at TYPE.secondary size or larger. Each row enters with translateY 12 px to 0 through arrive(prog(f, s_i, s_i + 22, E.out)) and opacity on the same progress, rows 10 f apart; while held, the whole stack drifts upward at 0.4 px/f.
- **Ban-safe variant (the default):** Drop the muted lead word above the stack: fold it into the first row as a full-strength word at the keywords' size ('Built for teams', then 'agencies' and 'founders' on the rag), or cut it and let the keywords stand alone. Use an icon only where it is the product's own mark for that item, never a stock line icon; otherwise keep the rag with words alone. Keep the rag table, the 10 f row stagger and the 0.4 px/f drift. The full look relies on filler-text; use it only when the brand supplies that look.
- **Timing:** Rows 8-12 f apart (10 by default), 22 f each on E.out, 12 px rise. Hold the full stack 60-80 f with the drift, then exit in reading order 4 f apart.
- **Use when:** Listing three or four abstract capabilities, platforms or audiences that would otherwise be a bullet list; a 'works across X, Y, Z' beat.
- **Avoid when:** More than four items, items longer than two words, or icons that decorate rather than mean something (then drop them and keep the rag).

### A row of icons arrives staggered, the chosen one last

`dv-icon-row-stagger` · micro-interactions · workhorse · energy calm · any

Toolbar icons fade in one after another and the chosen one gets a filled tile behind it last; app icons develop into some slots in random order on the strongest hit.

- **Build:** Cards / kit Glyph with starts; Develop for the slots. Anatomy: Stagger 3, 3, 9 f; fades 5 f; random-order develop 1 f apart. Sound: The strongest hit for the develop.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Cards`
- **Timing:** 20-30 f.
- **Use when:** Toolbars, app grids, options.
- **Avoid when:** Even stagger for the chosen item (give it a beat more).

### Icons and badges pop in with a small life

`dv-icon-pop` · micro-interactions · workhorse · energy calm · any

Small icons arrive with character: a crown badge pops tilted onto the corner of the top icon; an emoji pops a beat after its bubble (40 % -> 100 %); a pixel icon flips in from a 1 px line in one frame, breathes and flashes white; pixel blocks pop one by one and land with a small overshoot; a drawn clock's second hand ticks.

- **Build:** Oversize from 0.4-0.7 on E.snapOut (allowed for small icons), HardStep for flips. Anatomy: Pops front-loaded 6-8 f; flips 1 f; breath +5-8 %; overshoot small. Sound: A chat pop or none. Materials: Pictorial elements arrive at full size but out of focus and sharpen over 4-6 f (blur 8 -> 3 -> 0 px, no scale), while saturation goes pale to full; text never does this. A block can also be born inside a letter of the word and slide to its slot as the word shrinks (6 f).
- **Primitive:** `fx/Oversize`
- **Materials:** Pictorial elements arrive at full size but out of focus and sharpen over 4-6 f (blur 8 -> 3 -> 0 px, no scale), while saturation goes pale to full; text never does this. A block can also be born inside a letter of the word and slide to its slot as the word shrinks (6 f).
- **Timing:** 5-30 f.
- **Use when:** Badges, emoji, small rewards and states.
- **Avoid when:** Every icon popping at once.

### Line icon draws itself on

`dv-icon-draw-on` · micro-interactions · workhorse · energy calm · any

A line icon draws its strokes on (a paper plane while its bubble slides in; icons drawing onto objects, then updating; an icon rising inside a sphere as it blooms; an icon that breathes +12 % while its stroke inks in).

- **Build:** SVG paths with strokeDrawn() or a dash tween. Anatomy: Draw-on 8-17 f roughly linear; 5 px stroke at about 70 px icons. Sound: Soft ticks; the voice onset.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Stepped.strokeDrawn`
- **Timing:** 8-34 f.
- **Use when:** Icons in UI moments; labelling objects.
- **Avoid when:** Filled icons (the draw-on needs strokes).

### A dot grows into an icon

`dv-dot-grows-into-icon` · micro-interactions · accent · energy medium · any

A 4 px dot appears, becomes a rounded blob, then a thick plus already rotated that spins -90 deg into place; a point grows over 3 frames, jumps 4x in one frame on a note, settles and shrinks to a point; tiny dots scattered around a folder grow into file icons in a quick stagger while the folder pops.

- **Build:** MorphChain dot -> blob -> icon; SnapZoom-style one-frame jump on the note. Anatomy: Growth 12 f; snap 85 % in 1 f; settle 15 f; icons 10 f each staggered. Sound: A soft UI pop; the snap on an arpeggio note; pop SFX.
- **Primitive:** `fx/MorphChain`
- **Timing:** 12-48 f.
- **Use when:** Building icons from nothing; motifs on a musical note.
- **Avoid when:** Icons fading in.

### Companion icon swaps on every tick

`dv-ticking-icon-swap` · micro-interactions · accent · energy medium · launch, feature

A square icon tile beside a list changes its outline icon on every tick of the list (code, document, data, crop, image, link), one state every 4 frames.

- **Build:** HardStep over an icon list. Anatomy: One-frame swaps; 4 f per state. Sound: Ticks.
- **Primitive:** `fx/HardStep`
- **Timing:** 10 f per state.
- **Use when:** Showing formats or types passing through.
- **Avoid when:** Icons that are hard to read at speed.

### Blob launches, stretches, hangs and falls

`dv-blob-launch-arc` · micro-interactions · signature · energy medium · launch, feature

A blob pops off a bar as a small dot, rises above it stretched along its travel during the fastest frames, hangs at the top, and falls back: squash and stretch used once, on the one object that jumps.

- **Build:** Build: launchHangFall(f, { at, height }) (fx/Flight): up 29 f on E.glideOut, hang 8 f, down 21 f on E.buildIn; stretchOf(speed) gives the 1.38 : 1 stretch along the travel on the fastest frames only; anim squash() on the landing. Anatomy: Stretch 1.38:1 along travel for the fastest 4 f; hang 8 f; cubic up and down. Sound: Launch on a kick; land on the next kick.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Flight`
- **Timing:** Up 29 f, hang 8 f, down 21 f.
- **Use when:** A playful launch of a single element (an idea leaving the bar).
- **Avoid when:** Stretch on type or UI panels.
